tokens.name: bg
tokens.usage: Page background. Dark value is the site's --bg; the light value is new (modo claro).

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Podium cards, table, tabs and select backgrounds, on bg.

tokens.name: text
tokens.usage: Body copy and names on bg and surface. 16.1:1 on bg dark, 16.6:1 light.

tokens.name: muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text (subtitle, table headers, unselected tabs, freshness note) on bg and surface. 5.6:1 or more in both themes.

tokens.name: border
tokens.usage: 1px hairlines around cards, table, tabs and select. Decorative: the source value is about 1.4:1 on bg, below the 3:1 floor for control borders, kept exact from the site; a control must also be told apart by its text.

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: Lime FILL: selected tab, CTA button. Always pair with on-accent text. Never use as text on a light surface, use accent-text.

tokens.name: on-accent
tokens.usage: Text on accent fills. 14.6:1.

tokens.name: accent-text
tokens.usage: Lime as TEXT or outline: the page title, values, first-place border, on bg and surface. 13.5:1 dark, 6.9:1 light. The light value is new, a darker green of the same hue.

tokens.name: amber
tokens.usage: Positions, the sample-data notice and the focus ring, on bg and surface. 9:1 dark, 5.9:1 light. The light value is new.

styles.name: hero-title
styles.usage: Site title on desktop, in accent-text.

styles.name: title
styles.usage: Site title on phone (direction C), in accent-text.

styles.name: tab
styles.usage: Category tab on phone, in muted; the selected tab is weight 600 on accent with on-accent text. Desktop mockup uses 0.9rem.

styles.name: note
styles.usage: Freshness note and limits, in muted, with the // prefix in amber.

styles.name: position
styles.usage: Position in a list row (4, 5, 6), in amber.

styles.name: position-podium
styles.usage: Position on a podium card (#1), in amber.

styles.name: value
styles.usage: Value on a podium card, in accent-text. Desktop mockup uses 1.25rem.

styles.name: value-row
styles.usage: Value on a list row, in accent-text.

styles.name: summary
styles.usage: Summary of the other categories, always labeled: racha · máx · PRs · ★. In muted. Never below 12px.

styles.name: meta
styles.usage: Label next to the title: top · 12 meses. In muted.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Tight gaps (hero paragraph top margin).

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Gap between category tabs.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Podium gap, select padding, small gaps.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Control gap, tab and cell horizontal padding.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Page gutter, podium card padding.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Block spacing (hero bottom, podium bottom).

tokens.name: space-7
tokens.usage: Podium first-place bottom padding, status padding.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Hero top padding.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Tabs, select, notice.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: CTA button, podium cards.

tokens.name: radius-full
tokens.usage: Avatars.
